name: datalib-tauri
//: Pins the Tauri CLI that build-signed-app.sh runs (`pnpm exec tauri build`) through pnpm-lock.yaml, so the signing job resolves nothing from the registry at signing time with the Developer ID certificate in its environment; a bare `pnpm dlx @tauri-apps/cli@2` picked whatever 2.x was current that day. Installed with --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts: the CLI's platform binary is an integrity-pinned optional dependency, not an install script.
